blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
The right tools make the day easy. A laptop, a phone, a report, a folder and a pen — these are the daily tools of a Czarnikow desk.

Today we use have and has. We say who is carrying what. "I have a laptop." "She has the report." "He has my phone." We say who is ready for the meeting.

Today you learn 5 useful words and you practise a lot. Take your time. Every sentence counts.

items.q: What makes the day easy, according to the text?
items.why: "The right tools make the day easy."

items.q: Which words are the daily tools of a Czarnikow desk?
options: Laptop, phone, report, folder and pen
items.why: "A laptop, a phone, a report, a folder and a pen."

items.q: Which grammar do we use today?
items.why: "Today we use have and has."

items.q: The text says "Take your time." This suggests the author wants you to…
items.why: Inferência: "Take your time. Every sentence counts." — a ideia é ir com calma.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: every sentence is useful when you learn
tools do not help your work
you must learn many words in one day
items.why: Inferência: "Every sentence counts" e "5 useful words" mostram que ele valoriza cada frase e a prática.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie na mesa dela no Czarnikow. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning. My name is Sophie. Let me show you my desk.

I have a laptop. It is small and fast. I have a phone here too. My phone has all my numbers. On my desk I have two folders. One folder is blue and one folder is red. I have a report in the blue folder. The report is for the meeting today.

My friend Tom sits next to me. He has a black laptop. He has three pens on his desk. Tom has a big coffee every morning. He is always ready.

Now, I have a meeting at ten. I have my laptop, I have my phone, and I have the report. I have my folder too. I think I have everything. Good. Let's go to the meeting. Have a nice day.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does Sophie have on her desk?
options: A laptop, a phone and two folders
items.why: "I have a laptop… I have a phone… I have two folders."

items.q: Where is the report?
items.why: "I have a report in the blue folder."

items.q: What does Tom have?
options: A black laptop and three pens
A blue folder and a report
items.why: "He has a black laptop. He has three pens on his desk."

items.q: Why does Sophie check her laptop, phone, report and folder?
options: Because she is ready for the meeting
Because she wants to go home
items.why: Inferência: ela lista tudo antes do meeting das dez — está checando se está pronta.

items.q: The words "He is always ready" about Tom suggest that…
options: Tom is usually well prepared for work
Tom does not like his job
items.why: Inferência: "always ready" — Tom costuma estar preparado.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I write my notes with a pen." A pen is…
items.why: Pen = caneta, usada para escrever.

items.q: "She reads the numbers in the report." A report is…
items.why: Report = relatório, um documento com informação.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I put all my papers in one ___."
items.why: Folder = pasta, onde guardamos papéis.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I answer my emails on my ___."
items.why: Laptop = computador portátil, usado para email e trabalho.

items.q: "He calls a client on his phone." A phone is…
items.why: Phone = telefone, usado para ligar e falar.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples do dia a dia no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "I am ready for the meeting." Ready for means…
items.why: Ready for = pronto/preparado para algo.

items.q: "Can you write down the number?" To write down means to…
items.why: Write down = anotar, escrever no papel.

items.q: "Please send over the report." To send over means to…
items.why: Send over = mandar/enviar algo para alguém.

items.q: "Let's go through the numbers together." To go through means to…
items.why: Go through = revisar, passar por item a item.

items.q: "I need to pick up my phone from the desk." To pick up means to…
items.why: Pick up = pegar/apanhar um objeto.
